title: 第25章 瑶光1第26章 瑶光2
content_zh:
宁宁在进入世界以前，倒是认真看了这位女战神的要求，然后不由点了点头！
没错，她就是喜欢这种家国天下的任务，那些恋爱脑的让她简直敬谢不敏！
其实她对心怀苍生的瑶光上神还是很有好感的！
瑶光上神对于自己痴恋墨渊倒是没有后悔，但她后悔的是自己连累了素锦一族，看着素锦后人的下场，瑶光只觉得这天界令人厌恶恶心！
九重天明明应该是世人所向往的神圣之地，但却硬生生被改造成了勾心斗角之所！！
看着神魔大战时的好友对自己的评价，瑶光心里不是不难受，但人有远近亲疏，他们选择墨渊并没有错，自己也没有立场怪他们，但他们却忘了自己肩负的责任！
明明应该被厚待照顾的功臣之后，却硬生生在所有人的漠视和逼迫下走上了不归路！
每个人都戴着自己虚伪的面具，一步步将素锦一族吃干抹净！
看完一切的瑶光心里只有一个想法，那就是掀翻这个天界，还四海八荒一个朗朗乾坤！
宁宁到这个世界的时间有一些不凑巧，这会原主和墨渊已经在苍梧之巅决斗过了，结果毫无意外的败了。
如今瑶光正准备信守承诺，将瑾虞宫搬出昆仑墟！结果宁宁就来了！
一生好强的华夏女人——宁宁对这个时间点很不满，毕竟她不是原主瑶光，对墨渊并没有心生爱慕，反而觉得他虚伪！现在平白无故在四海八荒落得一个技不如人的名声，这让她怎么忍！
其实瑶光和墨渊的战斗力相差不大（私设），只是各有偏重而已，但一个是含恨出手的无情人，一个是爱慕对家的原主，这结果能赢就怪了！不过现在换成她来，那就......
瑶光看着自己的侍女，斩钉截铁的说道：“墨竹、熙竹?，加快速度，我们尽快离开！”
墨竹和熙竹?虽然不知道刚刚还在伤神的主子怎么突然变了口风，但她们也不会多问。
“是”
看着瑾虞宫真的从昆仑墟消失，四海八荒倒是议论纷纷。
墨渊的众位弟子倒是十分高兴，毕竟于他们而言，师傅的意愿才是第一位，瑶光上神对司音的所作所为令他们不齿，现在离开了也好，他们还清净了呢！
天君倒是不安居多，毕竟翼族擎苍虎视眈眈，手里更是掌握着毁天灭地的东皇钟，如今天族两大战神决裂，难免会影响之后的战斗，想到这，天君对司音的不满更多了！
天君对司音的不满由来已久！当日他想让自家儿子拜师昆仑墟，但却被墨渊毫不留情的拒绝了，紧接着就收下了一只来历不明的野狐狸，这让他的面子往哪放！

玉清昆仑扇更是有震慑四海之威，自己尚且没有得到，就被墨渊随手送了出去，这让天君怎么能忍！
现如今大敌当前，这司音又出来找事，这让天君对司音的不满也更上一层楼！
其他人对瑶光上神的离开倒是没什么感觉，最多也就是感慨下墨渊上神的郎心似铁！
content_en:
Before Ning Ning entered the world, she carefully read the request of the female war goddess, and then nodded involuntarily!
That's right, she just likes this kind of mission of family, country and world, and she can't thank those who are in love!
In fact, she still has a good impression of God Yaoguang who cares about the common people!
God Yaoguang has no regrets about her infatuation with Mo Yuan, but what she regrets is that she has caused trouble to the Sujin clan. Seeing the fate of Sujin's descendants, Yaoguang only feels that this world is disgusting and disgusting!
Jiuchongtian should be a sacred place that the world longs for, but it has been transformed into a place of intrigue! !
Seeing the comments made by her friends during the war between gods and demons, Yaoguang felt uncomfortable, but people are close and distant. It was not wrong for them to choose Mo Yuan, and she had no position to blame them, but they forgot the responsibility they shouldered!
The hero who should have been treated kindly and cared for was suddenly on the road of no return due to everyone's indifference and coercion!
Everyone wears their own hypocritical mask and eats up the Sujin clan step by step!
After seeing everything, Yao Guang only had one thought in his mind, which was to overthrow this world and bring peace to the world!
The timing of Ning Ning's arrival in this world was somewhat unlucky. At this time, the original owner and Mo Yuan had already dueled at the top of Cangwu, and they lost without any surprise.
Now Yaoguang is preparing to keep his promise and move Jinyu Palace out of Kunlun Ruins! As a result, Ning Ning came!
Ning Ning, a Chinese woman who has been very strong all her life, is very dissatisfied at this point in time. After all, she is not the original owner Yao Guang. She has no deep love for Mo Yuan, but feels that he is hypocritical! How could she endure the fact that she now had a reputation for being inferior to others all over the world for no reason!
In fact, Yao Guang and Mo Yuan's fighting abilities are not much different (privately designed), they just have different emphasis. But one is a ruthless person who attacks with hatred, and the other is the original owner who loves his opponent. It's strange that they can win! But now if it were her, then...
Yao Guang looked at his maid and said decisively: "Mo Zhu, Xizhu?, speed up, let's leave as soon as possible!"
Mo Zhu and Xizhu? Although they don’t know why their master, who was still worried just now, suddenly changed his tone, they won’t ask any more questions.
"Yes"
Seeing that Jinyu Palace really disappeared from Kunlun Ruins, people all over the world were talking about it.
Mo Yuan's disciples were very happy. After all, for them, the master's wishes came first. What God Yaoguang did to Si Yin made them despise them. It's good that they leave now, they are still clean!
Tianjun was mostly uneasy. After all, Qing Cang of the Wing Clan was eyeing him, and he held in his hand the East Emperor Bell that would destroy the world. Now that the two war gods of the Tianzu are breaking up, it will inevitably affect the subsequent battles. Thinking of this, Tianjun is even more dissatisfied with Si Yin!
Tianjun has been dissatisfied with Si Yin for a long time! That day, he wanted his son to become a disciple of Kunlun Ruins, but Mo Yuan refused without mercy. Then he accepted a wild fox of unknown origin. Where did he lose his face?
The Yuqing Kunlun Fan has the power to shock the world. Mo Yuan gave it away without even getting it. How could Tianjun endure it!
Now that the enemy is facing us, Si Yin comes out to look for trouble again, which makes Tianjun's dissatisfaction with Si Yin even higher!
Others didn't feel much about the departure of Lord Yaoguang. At most, they lamented Lord Mo Yuan's iron heart!
